title: Opportunity
description: The single strongest, defensible reason to contact a business. Produced by the opportunity-selector step (prompts/opportunity-selector.md) from the quick-audit output. Exactly one primary opportunity per lead — never a list of issues. V2 evidence model: every claim in `finding`/`business_consequence` must trace to at least one item in `evidence[]`, each with its own source and timestamp -- email generation is only allowed to cite facts that appear here.

finding.description: One-sentence statement of the strongest finding (same content as quick_audit.strongest_finding, carried forward)

supporting_evidence.description: Concrete, checkable observation, not a generic claim (kept for V1 compatibility; prefer `evidence[]` for anything new)

source_reference.description: e.g. a market.json path or ranking-import row, when there's no single URL

evidence.description: One item per distinct fact used in this opportunity. Email generation may only cite facts that appear here.

business_consequence.description: Why this costs the business money/leads, in plain terms

free_recommendation.description: One actionable, no-strings-attached fix the business could apply themselves

sources.description: URLs / agent outputs / market cache files this opportunity is grounded in (flat list; evidence[] carries the per-fact detail)

observed_at.description: When this opportunity was determined -- used for stale-finding checks (config/limits.yaml: finding_freshness_days)

pages_checked.description: URLs actually inspected while forming this opportunity
